name: Kawi Voyage – Island Charters & Tours
name_es: Kawi Voyage – Tours y Taxi Marítimo
location: Isla Colón / Bocas Town (Carenero, Bastimentos, Solarte, Zapatilla)
hours: Daily: ~6:00 AM – 7:00 PM • Custom charter & night trips upon request
description: 10 años de experiencia en ecoturismo en Bocas del Toro. Taxi marítimo entre islas, traslados privados y más de 20 excursiones guiadas: Cayo Zapatilla, Bahía Honda, bioluminiscencia, pesca y tour de chocolate.
description_en: 10 years experience in ecotourism in Bocas del Toro. Island-to-island water taxi, private charters, and 20+ guided tours: Cayo Zapatilla, Bahía Honda, bioluminescence, sport fishing, and native village tours.

tour_offerings.details: Full day island exploration and reef snorkeling
Night water excursion to experience natural bioluminescence
Calm water expedition into subterranean bat caves
Authentic indigenous cultural and organic cacao tour
Guided snorkeling tour with reef conservation focus

name: Capt. Justo Pineda Hawkins (Papito) – Papito's Nature Tours
name_es: Capt. Justo Pineda Hawkins (Papito) – Papito's Nature Tours
badge: Hope Spot Certified • Papito's Nature Tours
certifications: Licencia Oficial de Capitán de Lanchas
location: Dolphin Bay, Isla San Cristóbal • Pickups at Isla Colón (3R Mall), Carenero, Bastimentos, Solarte
departure_dock: Muelle 3R Mall (Calle 1ra / Av. Norte, Isla Colón) o Muelle Dolphin Bay (Isla San Cristóbal)
hours: Daily: ~6:00 AM – 7:00 PM • Custom private day charters & night trips upon request
description: Capitán nativo de Bocas del Toro y guía especializado en fauna silvestre. Operador de Papito's Nature Tours. Tours privados éticos: avistamiento responsable de delfines en Bahía de los Delfines, senderismo en el Santuario de Perezosos (Finca Montezuma en Isla San Cristóbal), manatíes en San San Pond Sak, ranas dardo venenosas y traslados privados entre islas en lancha segura y techada.
description_en: Native Bocas boat captain & licensed wildlife guide. Operator of Papito's Nature Tours. Specializing in ethical private charters: responsible dolphin watching in Dolphin Bay, guided hikes in the Sloth Forest Sanctuary (Finca Montezuma, Isla San Cristóbal), West Indian manatee expeditions in San San Pond Sak, strawberry poison dart frogs, and island-to-island water transfers.

tour_offerings.tour: Dolphin Bay & Sloth Forest Sanctuary Tour
tour_offerings.details: Responsible ethical dolphin watching in Dolphin Bay followed by guided native wildlife hike in the Sloth Forest Sanctuary at Finca Montezuma on Isla San Cristóbal

tour_offerings.tour: San San Pond Sak Manatee Wetland Expedition
tour_offerings.details: Navigating protected coastal wetlands to spot wild West Indian manatees and tropical river wildlife

tour_offerings.tour: Poison Dart Frog & Birding Photo Charter
tour_offerings.details: Specialized eco-tour tracking strawberry poison dart frogs (Oophaga pumilio) and Bocas canopy birds
Private custom charter to the outer Zapatilla cays with pristine coral reef snorkeling
Safe, shaded private transfers between Bocas Town, Carenero, Bastimentos, and villa docks

hours: Daily: ~6:00 AM – 7:00 PM • Tours depart 10:00 AM • Custom trips upon request

tour_offerings.details: Full day excursion to Cayo Zapatilla including snorkeling and island exploration
Coastal and island sport fishing expedition

tour_offerings.description: Guided reef snorkeling in crystal clear waters

rainy_day_policy: Tours a la Cueva de Murciélagos (Bat Cave en Bastimentos) para días lluviosos y rutas de aguas calmas adaptadas
rainy_day_policy_en: Bat Cave tours on Bastimentos for rainy days and weather-adapted calm-water routes negotiated per group
description: Capitán certificado Hope Spot (Ngabe Tours). Ubicado al frente de Klika (en el new store). Salidas diarias de tours a las 10:00 AM. Especialista en tours a Cayo Zapatilla ($40/persona con snorkel), pesca deportiva ($350 para aprox. 2 personas), expedición a la Cueva de Murciélagos (Bat Cave en Bastimentos, ideal para días lluviosos) y traslados frecuentes a Red Frog, Bastimentos, Bambuda Lodge y Carenero.
description_en: Hope Spot Certified captain (Ngabe Tours). Docked in front of Klika (at the new store, Calle 1ra). Daily tour departures at 10:00 AM. Specialist in Cayo Zapatilla tours ($40/person with snorkeling), sport fishing ($350 for ~2 people), Bat Cave cavern tours on Bastimentos (ideal for rainy days), and fast transfers to Red Frog, Bastimentos, Bambuda Lodge, and Carenero.
source: Bocas Hope Spot Certified Captains Directory

description: Equipo de capitanes con licencia de operador de lanchas. Junior Ortiz es Guía General de Turismo certificado en Panamá. Especialistas en tours privados lejos de aglomeraciones, bioluminiscencia y snorkeling. Embarques desde el muelle secundario de Panamá Sailing (partner con Capi Daniel). Incluye cooler con hielo y agua, alimentación y equipo de snorkel. Servicio de taxi para Boya de Vida y Floating Bar. Agentes autorizados de Air Panamá.
description_en: Team of licensed boat captains. Junior Ortiz is a certified General Tourism Guide in Panama. Specializing in crowd-free private island tours, bioluminescence, and snorkeling. Embarkations from Panama Sailing secondary dock (partnered with Capi Daniel). Includes cooler with ice and water, daily lunch, and snorkel gear. Water taxi to Boya de Vida & Floating Bar. Authorized Air Panama ticket agents.
